verses.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout to YHWH, all the earth.

segments.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout to YHWH, all the earth.

verses.text: Serve YHWH with gladness! Come before His face with a shout of joy!

segments.text: Serve YHWH with gladness! Come before His face with a shout of joy!

verses.text: Know that YHWH, He [is] God; He has made us and not we ourselves; [we are] His people and the sheep of His pasture.

segments.text: Know that YHWH, He [is] God; He has made us and not we ourselves; [we are] His people and the sheep of His pasture.

verses.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise; give thanks to Him; bless His name!

segments.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courts with praise; give thanks to Him; bless His name!

verses.text: For YHWH [is] good; forever [is] His loving devotion, and unto generation and generation His faithfulness.

segments.text: For YHWH [is] good; forever [is] His loving devotion, and unto generation and generation His faithfulness.
